method: Read-only scoped diff review and current-source identity/anchor checks; no build, product edit, browser state, generation or media request.
sourceObservations: Shared lesson runtime adds hash-target disclosure opening and visible step/completion controls; existing answer gates, record mutations, native media callbacks and cross-tab handlers are preserved.
Course home retains the exact required completion conditions and adds chapter/search rendering; it does not introduce a practice-test gate.
Assessment changes remain dashboard/study-insight DOM/copy only; prior practice-preservation report binds the untouched runtime functions.
Shared lesson template preserves player/caption/dialog hooks, all authored question teaching anchors, optional source content and foundation widgets.
The build now generates foundation pages through the shared template; no current lesson data or caption bytes changed.
Third-party OFL license trailing whitespace is not an application behavior change and was preserved by root.
limits: This source audit checks the identified presentation changes and preservation conditions. It does not independently execute every browser path; parent and independent-agent browser reports cover behavior.
